purpose: This table is a static reference lookup of the sixteen airline carriers that flew from New York City airports in 2013, mapping each two-letter carrier code to its full legal carrier name; it feeds joins against flight-level fact tables keyed on carrier code.
usage: Join downstream flight tables to this table on the carrier column to resolve human-readable airline names; both carrier and name are fully populated (null_rate 0.0) and carrier is unique, so it is safe to use as a lookup key without additional filtering.
limitations: The table is tiny (16 rows) and reflects only the carriers observed in the 2013 nycflights13 source extract; it excludes any airbyte capture metadata and does not capture carriers that began or ceased NYC service after that period.
